
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/19704536" title="发布于 2026-03-11 20:47">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">不用复杂操作，腾讯 QQ 开放 OpenClaw“小龙虾”官方接入！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>你养“龙虾”了吗？这句看似玩笑的问候，正成为 2026 年科技圈最火热的社交暗号。过去几个月，OpenClaw 以势不可挡的姿态席卷全球，不仅在 GitHub 狂揽 270K+ Star，登顶史上最受欢迎开源项目，更催生了“赛博养虾”的新兴文化。从开发者论坛到街头巷尾，从499/999元的上门部署服务到闲鱼爆火的“龙虾驯养指南”，这场由AI智能体掀起的生产力革命，正在重塑人与机器的协作方式。</span></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>现如今腾讯 QQ 重磅推出官方接入通道，无需复杂配置，无需代码基础，只需一键绑定，你的 QQ 就能化身“龙虾饲养员”。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204457943-636930755.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>OpenClaw 是什么？</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>OpenClaw 是一款本地优先、完全开源的新一代 AI 助手。它直接部署在你的 macOS、Windows 或 Linux 设备（及服务器）上，将大模型的智慧与您的操作系统深度融合。它不仅能理解上下文，更拥有长时记忆与系统级权限，能真正“动手”执行文件管理、数据抓取、应用操控等真实任务。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>openclaw 开源地址：<a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw</a></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204516653-84028568.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>快速搭建AI私人QQ助理</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>登录地址：<a href="https://q.qq.com/qqbot/openclaw/login.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://q.qq.com/qqbot/openclaw/login.html</a></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204537447-1753100852.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>登录后，点击创建机器人，每个 QQ 账号可以注册 5 只独立 AI 机器人，创建的机器人昵称、头像、简介可以自由修改。</span></p>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204548585-1791976284.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204555495-862768512.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204601341-117289905.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204606704-505787818.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>支持的消息类型</span></h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202603/1336199-20260311204618171-1375909004.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>OpenClaw原生接入流程</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>一、安装OpenClaw开源社区QQBot插件</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/Q3auHgzwzM5JXwn4AFwAGmzC4o7cyfibOpKKchVIoWLwvez0A6jKLAsXNH4Iia9k0lib4UVNICDWibyEvHvCCEZ6uSB6E1yn0DFGUyiasbgA982lDiaHSmjtbZIg/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>openclaw plugins install @sliverp/qqbot@latest<span><br></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>二、配置绑定当前QQ机器人</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/Q3auHgzwzM7tpbuDmSG6jiaOXaQTkFD9D5yEFa0p4S26A7jibZluWXBBVzney0bJvpGaYA8tyE2ibRewCXHq8RlYNYw0xG2ic2sxicGDMQKceEzOagkH93STwRA/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>openclaw channels add --channel qqbot --token&nbsp;"xxx:xxxx"<span><br></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>三、重启本地OpenClaw服务</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/Q3auHgzwzM4JdL0gWUibicc1vVH51bPSOibcPHQ7xfXyjFJzHb7QDZvVwJmNPrbt3NarLEm3sBdYLicAQcuNI8IvZzxbckg8xGroBxzzbp2vI1lwGkcmf40KicQ/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>openclaw gateway restart<span><br></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>腾讯云部署 OpenClaw 教程</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>腾讯云提供可视化配置面板，只需几步即可快速完成操作，极简接入！</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><a href="https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2626045" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span>https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2626045</span></a></li>
</ul>
